description: DS-to-DS federation endpoint: transfer the sequencer role for a conversation from the current sequencer to this DS.

main.description: Accept a sequencer role transfer from the current sequencer DS. The caller must be the current sequencer for the conversation. After a successful transfer, this DS becomes the new sequencer responsible for epoch ordering.

convoId.description: Conversation identifier for which the sequencer role is being transferred

currentEpoch.description: The current MLS epoch at the time of transfer, used to establish continuity

accepted.description: Whether the sequencer role transfer was accepted

errors.name: ConversationNotFound
errors.description: The conversation does not exist on this DS

errors.name: NotCurrentSequencer
errors.description: The calling DS is not the current sequencer for this conversation

errors.name: NotAuthorized
errors.description: The calling DS is not authorized for this conversation
